query_ground_truth.query: update Trello card status and activity logs
query_ground_truth.intent: Move the published card to a completed list on Trello and append execution details to the card's activity log.

append activity logs as a comment on the card

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if Posted list id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch board lists using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD to identify the destination idList for “Posted”.
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm with the user that updating the card, publishing a log comment, and moving it to “Posted” is intended (public/irreversible impact).
[Required] [Step]: (Optional per file) Add required attachment(s) to the card using TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ATTACHMENTS_BY_ID_CARD (ensure each file is the correct final asset).
[Required] [Step]: Update card fields (e.g., name/desc/due/members) using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD to reflect the final posted state.
[Required] [Step]: Publish the posting log as a card comment using TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_CARD (include links/notes needed for audit trail).
[Required] [Step]: Move the card to the “Posted” list using TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_ID_LIST_BY_ID_CARD (uses destination idList).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Fetch the card using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD to verify attachments/comments and the new idList are present.
known_pitfalls: [TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_ID_LIST_BY_ID_CARD] Requires the destination idList; list names/labels aren’t accepted as a move target.
[TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD] Boards can return multiple similarly named lists; verify you select the correct “Posted” list (and not a closed/archived one).
[TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD] Avoid sending fields you don’t intend to change to prevent accidental overwrites.
[TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_CARD] Comments act as a persistent audit log—double-check sensitive/internal details before publishing.

TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ATTACHMENTS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Adds an attachment to a Trello card by `idCard`; specify either a `file` to upload or a `url` to link, but not both.

url.description: URL of an external resource to attach if not uploading a `file`. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.

file.description: Path to the local file to attach if not linking a `url`.

name.description: Desired name for the attachment. If omitted, Trello uses the original filename or a URL-derived default. Max length 256.

idCard.description: ID or shortLink of the Trello card.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the attachment, aiding Trello in file handling. Max length 256.

TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.description: Updates an existing Trello card's attributes like name, description, due date, members, labels, position, or archives/unarchives it, attaches files, or changes its cover.

due.description: The new due date for the card, in ISO 8601 format, or 'null' to remove the due date.

pos.description: The new position of the card within its list. Can be 'top', 'bottom', or a positive floating-point number. Higher numbers are further down the list.

desc.description: The new description for the card. String length must be from 0 to 16384 characters.

name.description: The new name for the card. Required if not copying the name from `idCardSource`, `fileSource`, or `urlSource`.

closed.description: Determines whether the card should be archived (closed). Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to update.

idList.description: The ID of the list to move the card to.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label colors (e.g., 'green,yellow,red') to apply, overwriting existing labels. Use 'idLabels' for more precise control. 'all' may add all available label colors.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to move the card to. If `idList` is also provided, the card will be moved to that list on the new board.

idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to apply, replacing existing labels. To preserve existing labels, fetch current `idLabels`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign, replacing existing members. To preserve existing members, fetch current `idMembers`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

urlSource.description: A URL to be attached to the card (e.g., a link to an external resource). If the card is being created from a URL (e.g. via a bookmarklet), this will be the source URL. Set to 'null' or an empty string to remove an existing attachment link created this way.

fileSource.description: The URL of a file to be attached to the card. Trello will fetch and attach the file from this URL.

subscribed.description: Determines whether the user is subscribed to the card. Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCardSource.description: The ID of a card to copy properties from. Requires `keepFromSource` to be specified.

keepFromSource.description: If `idCardSource` is specified, this is a comma-separated list of properties to copy from the source card. Valid values are 'all', or any combination of 'attachments', 'checklists', 'comments', 'customFields', 'due', 'labels', 'members', 'pluginData', 'stickers'.

idAttachmentCover.description: The ID of an existing image attachment to be used as the card cover. Use 'null' or an empty string to remove the cover.

TRELLO_UPDATE_CARDS_ID_LIST_BY_ID_CARD.description: Moves a Trello card to a different list on the same Trello board; this operation is idempotent and only updates the card's list ID.

value.description: The ID of the target list to move the card to. Must be a valid, existing list ID (24-character hex string). The target list must be on the same board as the card.

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the card to be moved. Must be a valid, existing card ID. Card IDs can be short (e.g., `FY2OWrnc`) or long 24-character hex string (e.g., `571d07b591c8b68aeb4f6acc`).

TRELLO_ADD_CARDS_ACTIONS_COMMENTS_BY_ID_.description: Adds a new text comment, which can include @mentions, to a Trello card specified by its ID; file attachments are not supported via this action.

examples: What's the status on this task? @username
text.description: Comment text, between 1 and 16384 characters. Supports @mentions to notify Trello users.

idCard.description: ID or shortLink of the Trello card to add the comment to.
